app.title: Spice2x Remote
app.description: A cabinet controller for SpiceAPI over WebSocket.

connection.directHint: Actions go directly from the browser to the selected cabinet.
msg.initial: Enter a cabinet endpoint in Connection, or try the demo.

msg.gridOnly: Demo mode shows the calibration grid only.
error.storage: Browser storage is unavailable. Your current input still works.
error.name: Enter a cabinet name.
error.profileNotSaved: Connected, but this browser cannot save the profile. Enter it again after closing the page.
error.card: Card numbers need 16 hexadecimal characters (0–9, A–F).
error.savePassword: Enable an API password in spice2x and connect with it to save settings.
error.apply: Calibration failed. Adjust again before saving: {detail}
error.saveMismatch: Settings changed after saving. Reload and check the cabinet settings.
error.controlPassword: Connect with an API password to use system actions.
error.button: The cabinet does not provide a {label} button.
error.cardsChanged: Connection changed. Read the cards again.
error.noCapture: No screen is available for capture.

error.clipboard: Copy failed. Select and copy the text.

error.endpoint: Enter a complete WebSocket endpoint, e.g. ws://192.168.1.10:1338.

error.endpointOrigin: Embedded mode can connect only to this page's cabinet.
error.connectTimeout: Connection timed out. Check the endpoint, port and local-network permission.

error.changed: Connection changed; this action was not sent.
error.apiTimeout: API timed out. Connection closed to preserve cipher state. Check the API password and reconnect.
error.tooLarge: API response exceeds the size limit.
error.parse: API could not parse the request. Check the API password.
error.extra: Extra API response data; connection closed.
error.response: API response format or request ID does not match.
error.key: API did not provide a valid session key.

log.hint: Shows the latest 64 KiB. Download retrieves the complete log at the start of the request. An API password is required.
error.logChanged: The log changed while downloading. Refresh and try again.
error.logPassword: Connect with an API password to read logs.

options.sensitivePlaceholder: Enter a new value to change this setting

update.title: System update
update.connectHint: Connect to a cabinet before uploading a release.
update.selectHint: Choose the original release ZIP or the active Spice EXE.
update.signatureHint: Signature results identify the source; unverified files can still be updated.
update.applyHint: The game and API connection will restart. Continue only when the selected files are correct.
update.restartingHint: Waiting for the update request to finish…
update.reconnectHint: Waiting for a fresh cabinet connection and version…
error.updateDemo: System update is unavailable in demo mode.
error.updatePassword: Connect with an API secret to use system update.
error.updateUnavailable: System update is unavailable on this connection.
error.updateNoFiles: Select at least one executable before uploading.
error.updateInvalidSelection: Select the current Spice executable. spicecfg.exe can only be taken from a release ZIP.
error.updateInvalidFile: This release file is invalid or exceeds the safe size limits.
